components.name: Primary Button

ดวงจีนปาจื้อ (Bazi)

narrative.northStar: ห้องดูดวงของหมอดูรุ่นใหม่ (The Modern Diviner's Room)
narrative.overview: สายมู is a contemporary Thai fortune-teller's studio rendered as a website: velvet darkness, a single neon-amethyst light source, and a film-grain haze that makes every surface feel like night air. The room is mystical but never dusty — the หมอดู here reads Bazi charts next to an MBTI report. Density is low and theatrical on marketing surfaces, calm and legible inside the app; motion is ambient, never busy.
keyCharacteristics: Single-hue brand: everything purple, from void to orchid; other hues are reserved payloads
Film grain (3% opacity) over every page — the room's atmosphere
Glassmorphic cards floating on darkness, edged with white/10
Two voices: contemporary Thai (คุณ) for marketing, the oracle's เจ้า/ข้า in Sarabun Light inside readings
Dark-only by construction; no light theme

rules.name: The Amethyst Voice Rule
rules.body: Purple is the only brand hue. The five element colors appear exclusively when representing a user's ธาตุ — never as generic decoration. A future section extends the purple ladder; it does not introduce a new brand hue.

rules.name: The Grain Rule
rules.body: The 3% film-grain overlay is global and non-negotiable; never stack a second grain layer.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Marketing speaks contemporary Thai (คุณ) in Prompt/Noto Sans Thai; the oracle speaks as ข้า to เจ้า in Sarabun Light. Never mix registers in one sentence.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: If an element needs lift, it emits light from its own hue family; it never casts a gray drop shadow.

dos: Do keep every surface on the purple ladder; introduce element hues only as user-data payloads.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: suppress particles, video autoplay, and scale effects.
Do keep Thai body text at 400/1.75 and ≤ 68ch — readings are the product.
Do give every interactive element a ≥44px touch target.
Do add new public sections inside (marketing) and register them in the nav config only.
donts: Don't add a light theme, gray drop shadows, or pure #000/#FFF.
Don't use the oracle voice on marketing chrome, or คุณ inside the reading experience.
Don't stack a second grain/noise layer on any surface.
Don't use emoji as icons in UI chrome; emoji live only in share copy.
Don't center long-form Thai paragraphs; center only display lines of ≤2 rows.
